pharmacySolutions.title: Pharmacy Solutions (e-commerce)
pharmacySolutions.description: Pharma Solutions is a comprehensive e-commerce platform designed to provide a smooth, secure, and user-friendly experience for purchasing medicines and medical supplies online.

fekrativity.title: Fekrativity
fekrativity.description: Fekrativity is a professional events management agency that offers end-to-end services—from conceptual design and logistics to marketing and execution—using modern technologies like VR/AR and mobile applications to deliver immersive, tailored experiences for conferences, exhibitions, and other events.

wildOasis.title: Wild Oasis
wildOasis.description: Wild Oasis is a sleek, luxury cabin booking platform presenting immersive experiences in mountain-forest settings, complete with sections for exploration (Cabins), company background (About), and guest access, while featuring contact info and reservation management.

beautyCenter.title: Beauty Center
beautyCenter.description: Beauty Center is a premier Saudi Arabian e-commerce and B2B platform that unites local and global brands, offering over 800,000 women's lifestyle products through a feature-rich interface—highlighting user-friendly design, secure payments, inventory/order management, promotional tools, analytics, and dedicated partner support.

cashLab.title: Cash Lab
cashLab.description: A comprehensive and user-friendly medical laboratory management dashboard designed to streamline diagnostic workflows and data visualization. The platform provides real-time analytics for patient management, test performance tracking, and financial revenue monitoring.

discoverEgypt.title: Discover Egypt
discoverEgypt.description: A premium, content-driven platform designed to be the definitive companion for travelers in Egypt. Egypt Explorer bridges the gap between historical exploration and modern-day navigation, offering users verified insights into the country's most iconic landmarks, hidden gems, and local lifestyle.

ezyRent.title: EzyRent
ezyRent.description: A modern, high-performance real estate platform designed to simplify the process of finding and booking rental units globally. EzyRent provides a seamless search experience, allowing users to browse thousands of verified listings across different countries and districts with real-time availability.

keyper.title: Keyper
keyper.description: A high-end, professional landing page designed for Keyper, a leading real estate facilitation and advisory firm. The project focuses on presenting a premium brand image that guides clients through the entire property lifecycle—from initial discovery to final closing.
